schema.text: When you walk or use a wheelchair, do pleasant or unpleasant surroundings affect how you feel?
schema.help: For example buildings, squares, how cared-for a place is and its general feel. Think about the parts of a journey you make along streets or pavements, on foot or using a wheelchair.

options.text: No, I don't pay attention to them
I notice them, but they rarely make a difference
They affect a lot how I feel on the way
I sometimes choose a route because it's nicer or more interesting

en.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, do p: When you walk or use a wheelchair, do pleasant or unpleasant surroundings affect how you feel?
en.#No, I don't pay attention to them: No, I don't pay attention to them
en.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: I notice them, but they rarely make a difference
en.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: They affect a lot how I feel on the way
en.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: I sometimes choose a route because it's nicer or more interesting
en.#For example buildings, squares, how car: For example buildings, squares, how cared-for a place is and its general feel. Think about the parts of a journey you make along streets or pavements, on foot or using a wheelchair.

it.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, do p: Quando ti sposti a piedi o in sedia a rotelle, l’ambiente intorno, piacevole o sgradevole, influisce su come ti senti?
it.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: Ci faccio caso, ma raramente fanno differenza
it.#Sometimes they affect my mood: A volte influiscono sul mio umore
it.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: Influiscono molto su come mi sento lungo la strada
it.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: A volte scelgo un percorso perché è più bello o più interessante
it.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Per esempio edifici, piazze, quanto un luogo è curato e la sua atmosfera in generale. Pensa ai tratti che percorri lungo la strada o sul marciapiede, a piedi o in carrozzina.

fr.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, do p: Lorsque vous marchez ou vous déplacez en fauteuil roulant, un cadre agréable ou désagréable influence-t-il ce que vous ressentez ?
fr.#No, I don't pay attention to them: Non, je n'y fais pas attention
fr.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: Je les remarque, mais elles font rarement une différence
fr.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: Elles influencent beaucoup ce que je ressens en chemin
fr.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: Je choisis parfois un itinéraire parce qu'il est plus agréable ou plus intéressant
fr.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Par exemple les bâtiments, les places, l'entretien d'un lieu et son atmosphère générale. Pensez aux parties du trajet que vous parcourez dans la rue ou sur le trottoir, à pied ou en fauteuil roulant.

de.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, do p: Beeinflusst eine angenehme oder unangenehme Umgebung beim Gehen oder Fahren im Rollstuhl, wie Sie sich fühlen?
de.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: Ich merke es, aber es macht selten einen Unterschied
de.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: Sie beeinflussen stark, wie ich mich unterwegs fühle
de.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: Manchmal wähle ich eine Strecke, weil sie schöner oder interessanter ist
de.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Zum Beispiel Gebäude, Plätze, wie gepflegt ein Ort ist und wie er insgesamt wirkt. Denken Sie an die Wegabschnitte, die Sie auf Straßen oder Gehwegen zu Fuß oder im Rollstuhl zurücklegen.

tr.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, do p: Yürürken veya tekerlekli sandalyeyle ilerlerken hoş veya hoş olmayan çevre kendinizi nasıl hissettiğinizi etkiliyor mu?
tr.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: Fark ederim ama nadiren bir fark yaratırlar
tr.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: Bazen daha güzel veya ilginç olduğu için bir güzergâh seçerim
tr.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Örneğin binalar, meydanlar, bir yerin ne kadar bakımlı olduğu ve genel havası. Yolculuğunuzun sokaklarda veya kaldırımlarda yürüyerek ya da tekerlekli sandalyeyle yaptığınız bölümlerini düşünün.

fa.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, do p: هنگام پیاده‌روی یا حرکت با ویلچر، آیا محیط خوشایند یا ناخوشایند بر حال شما اثر می‌گذارد؟
fa.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: متوجه آن‌ها می‌شوم، اما به‌ندرت فرقی ایجاد می‌کنند
fa.#Sometimes they affect my mood: گاهی بر حال من اثر می‌گذارند
fa.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: خیلی بر حس من در مسیر اثر می‌گذارند
fa.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: گاهی مسیری را انتخاب می‌کنم چون زیباتر یا جالب‌تر است
fa.#For example buildings, squares, how car: مثلاً ساختمان‌ها، میدان‌ها، میزان رسیدگی به یک محل و حال‌وهوای کلی آن. بخش‌هایی از سفر را در نظر بگیرید که در خیابان یا پیاده‌رو، پیاده یا با ویلچر طی می‌کنید.

hu.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, do p: Gyaloglás vagy kerekesszékes közlekedés közben befolyásolja a közérzetét, ha kellemes vagy kellemetlen a környezet?
hu.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: Nagyon befolyásolják, hogyan érzem magam az úton
hu.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: Néha azért választok útvonalat, mert szebb vagy érdekesebb
hu.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Például az épületek, terek, egy hely gondozottsága és általános hangulata. Gondoljon az utazás azon szakaszaira, amelyeket az utcán vagy a járdán gyalog vagy kerekesszékkel tesz meg.

ar.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, do p: عند المشي أو التنقل بكرسي متحرك، هل تؤثر البيئة المحيطة، الجميلة أو غير الجميلة، في شعورك؟
ar.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: ألاحظها، لكنها نادرًا ما تُحدث فرقًا
ar.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: تؤثر كثيرًا في شعوري أثناء الطريق
ar.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: أختار أحيانًا طريقًا لأنه أجمل أو أكثر إثارة للاهتمام
ar.#For example buildings, squares, how car: مثل المباني والساحات ومدى العناية بالمكان وجوّه العام. فكّر في أجزاء الرحلة التي تقطعها في الشارع أو على الرصيف، مشيًا أو باستخدام كرسي متحرك.
